Thanks for this @lebaphi 

It's working in my browser. But, we're not getting date *and* time.   It's just date.  The `format` is specified as `datetime-local`, which is what `json-editor` says should be used.

I'm expecting an editor more like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/200872624-0a20cf29-aafd-49af-947c-7f5da23fbc44.png)

Any ideas?
let me check if the flatpickr provides some options to do that thing, but in tomorrow 😄

issues.title: Integrate `flatPickr`
issues.body:
We need our players to enter date-time values for new orders.

JSON-Editor supports the `flatpickr` component, but it's not working in our templates.

The text is locked, as-if JSON-Editor wants to make users user the control, but the control doesn't appear.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/6b39a2630ff89bd43074d01934e0e108.gif)

There is a story supporting this here: http://localhost:6611/?path=/story/local-form-elements-newmessage--just-land-activity (note: right now I haven't pushed that story yet, but will soon)
